systems.owner: SEN-CSU (Agence sénégalaise de la Couverture Sanitaire Universelle)

systems.system: SENUM national portal / Espaces Sénégal Services

note: Convention (2026-07) to interconnect the SEN-CSU platform with SENUM's national public-services portal for CSU enrolment; the portal is not a health information system and no health-to-health exchange is described, so no fact.

systems.owner: SEN-CSU (Agence sénégalaise de la Couverture Sanitaire Universelle)

note: Announcement of a partnership signing to route CSU enrolment through the Espaces Sénégal Services network; it describes no data exchange between health systems, so no fact.
A workshop to co-build a health interoperability roadmap is a policy with no exchange contracted or in service.

facts.fact: A GIZ-funded feasibility demonstration with Senegal's health ministry had three Senegalese hospital information system vendors (Patient Pro, Eyone, MedSen) test data exchange under IHE standards at the IHE Europe Connectathon 2024, passing about 90% of planned tests.

note: Only an infrastructure to secure and host health data is being set up; no exchange between health systems stated.
Says exchange between hospital systems is difficult; no exchange under way or in service.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that Senegal is developing a shared patient record to make health information portable across facilities and platforms.

note: Interoperability is an ambition of the roadmap; no exchange in service or being built is stated.
